items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: No, that was for (Marian) Sunshine, you know, Azpiazu?

ctx.x: Okay, we are moving now toward the end of '47. Your Verne records are still getting a little air play in jukeboxes; I don't know about the radio. Ahh, you already have in the book, I believe, "Me dejan Solito", those things that you did for Tico later on and Continental. How did you get a hold of those number? Were they Robbins numbers also?
No, that was for (Marian) Sunshine, you know, Azpiazu?
